Name: Go-To Shoulder Bag in Cognac Suede with Full-Grain Leather Flap
Short description: Handmade shoulder bag in cognac suede with a supple full-grain cowhide flap and an adjustable leather strap. Compact at 31 x 20 x 8 cm.
Description:
The bag you reach for without thinking: the Go-To pairs soft cognac suede with a flap of supple full-grain cowhide. It holds your everyday essentials while staying neat and compact on the shoulder.

  • Dimensions: 31 cm long, 20 cm high, 8 cm deep
  • Material: suede combined with supple full-grain cowhide
  • Shoulder strap: 3 cm wide, adjustable in length
  • Lining: cotton

Each bag is handmade to order by Fait d'or. The leather strap is fixed with two rivets and runs through a leather keeper, so you can easily set the length to suit how you like to carry it. The warm cognac suede and the slightly lighter smooth leather sit together calmly, working as well with jeans as with a smarter outfit.

The Confident is a compact handbag you can carry by its top handle or wear on your shoulder with the detachable strap. The warm avena suede is soft to the touch and works as easily with jeans as with a tailored coat.

The body is suede, paired with supple full-grain cowhide for the handle, the strap and the corner pieces at the base. A zip along the top keeps your things together, and the antique-brass-coloured hardware gives it a quiet finish. Each bag is made to order.

Name: Leather Sling Bag The Adventurer – Cognac Suede and Cowhide
Short description: A rounded sling bag in cognac suede with supple full-grain leather, worn over one shoulder or crossbody. Handmade once you order.
Description:
The Adventurer is a rounded bag on a single long strap, made to be worn over one shoulder or across the body. It keeps your hands free and your essentials close, whether you are walking through town or heading somewhere new.

The body is cut from sturdy split suede in a warm cognac shade. The top panel and strap are supple full-grain cowhide, with the Fait d'or logo discreetly embossed into the leather. Each bag is made by hand, only after it has been ordered.

  • Size: base diameter 18 cm, height 40 cm
  • Strap: long shoulder strap, length adjustable with a slider
  • Materials: full-grain cowhide combined with split suede
  • Lining: recycled cotton in a light natural tone

A simple, quiet shape that sits well with a wool coat or an everyday pair of jeans.
